_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: Tier 2 — retainer billing engine. Four new schemas (RetainerPool, RetainerDrawdown, RetainerRollover, RetainerTrueUp) for monthly retainer pools with drawdown tracking, rollover policy, and period-end true-up reconciliation. Drawdown-balance and actual-drawdown roll-ups are declarative x-openregister-aggregations per ADR-022 — no RetainerService.php. Immutable lifecycle (drawdown, rollover, true-up) via x-openregister-lifecycle; cross-field / cross-schema preconditions (non-overlapping periods, drawdown rate immutability, true-up duplicate prevention, settlement-before-rollover) delegated to OCA\Shillinq\Lifecycle\RetainerGuard (ADR-031 exception path — array-membership and cross-record lookups are not yet expressible in the declarative requires: DSL). Overage rate is resolved from the rate-card-engine RateCard/RateRecord schemas (dependency, already merged). clientId / projectId / timeEntryId / invoiceId / administrationId are entity references (a contact/person/administration is an NC/cross-app entity — never an invented schema). Seed data pre-loads a worked Jan-2026 Dutch-SMB example (two pools, four drawdowns, one true-up, one rollover).

RetainerPool.title: Retainer Pool
RetainerPool.description: Monthly retainer allocation per client/project with effective-date windows, retainer rate and rollover policy (REQ-RETN-001, design D1). Drawdowns consume the pool; period-end true-up reconciles actual vs. allocated. Non-overlapping periods per (clientId, projectId) pair are enforced by RetainerGuard::canActivatePool (ADR-031 exception). availableBalance and actualDrawdown roll up declaratively from RetainerDrawdown (ADR-022).

clientId.description: Entity reference to the client/contact this pool belongs to. A client is an NC/cross-app entity, never an invented schema (ADR-022).

projectId.description: Optional entity reference to a Project the pool is scoped to.

poolAmount.description: Allocated pool amount for the period, in the pool currency (REQ-RETN-001).

retainerRate.description: Configured retainer rate used for drawdown calculation (NOT the timesheet billable rate) (REQ-RETN-002, design D2).

retainerRateUnit.description: Unit the retainer rate is expressed in.

carryoverMax.description: Maximum carryover (interpreted in carryoverCapUnit). null = unlimited.

carryoverCapUnit.description: Whether carryoverMax is an amount or an hours count.

resetBalance.description: true = no carryover; balance resets each period.

administrationId.description: Administration / OU isolation reference. An administration is a cross-app entity (ADR-022).

sourcePoolId.description: Self-FK to the prior-period pool this pool rolls over from (REQ-RETN-009).

status.description: Pool lifecycle status (REQ-RETN-001). Pools created via rollover start as draft and require operator activation.

actualDrawdown.description: actual-drawdown = SUM(RetainerDrawdown.drawdownAmount) for materialized drawdowns of this pool (REQ-RETN-003 / design D4). Declarative — no RetainerService.php (ADR-022).

drawdownCount.description: Number of materialized drawdowns against the pool (REQ-RETN-010).

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Pool defined (or rolled over) but not yet active; editable.

active.label: Active
active.description: Pool is consuming drawdowns for the period (REQ-RETN-001). Non-overlapping periods enforced on activation.

inactive.label: Inactive
inactive.description: Period closed; pool no longer accepts new drawdowns.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: True-up settled and rolled over; immutable for historical queries (design D6).

activate.label: Activate pool
activate.description: Activate the pool for the period. Blocked when an overlapping active pool exists for the same client/project (REQ-RETN-001).

close.label: Close period
close.description: Close the period; no further drawdowns accepted.

archive.label: Archive
archive.description: Archive after true-up settlement and rollover (design D6).

RetainerDrawdown.title: Retainer Drawdown
RetainerDrawdown.description: Immutable record of a single TimeEntry's consumption of a retainer pool (REQ-RETN-002, design D2). drawdownAmount = hoursOrAmount × the pool's configured retainerRate (NOT the timesheet rate). Once materialized the record is immutable; corrections create a reversed/adjusted successor (audit trail intact). timeEntryId is an entity reference (a time entry is a cross-app entity, ADR-022).

timeEntryId.description: Entity reference to the consuming time entry (cross-app entity, ADR-022).

drawdownDate.description: Date of the time entry / consumption (REQ-RETN-002).

hoursOrAmount.description: Hours (or amount units) consumed from the pool (REQ-RETN-002).

drawdownRate.description: The pool's configured retainerRate at materialization time — immutable; later RateCard changes do not affect historical drawdowns (REQ-RETN-002, design D2).

reversalOf.description: Self-FK to the drawdown this record reverses/adjusts (corrections never overwrite).

status.description: Drawdown status (REQ-RETN-002). Immutable once materialized; corrections create a new record.

pending.label: Pending
pending.description: Drawdown created from a time entry, awaiting materialization.

materialized.label: Materialized
materialized.description: Drawdown counts against the pool balance (REQ-RETN-002). Immutable.

reversed.label: Reversed
reversed.description: Drawdown reversed by a successor record; no longer counts.

adjusted.label: Adjusted
adjusted.description: Drawdown superseded by an adjusted successor record.

materialize.label: Materialize
materialize.description: Materialize the drawdown against the pool. Blocked when drawdownAmount does not equal hoursOrAmount × the pool's retainerRate (REQ-RETN-002, design D2).

reverse.label: Reverse
reverse.description: Reverse a materialized drawdown (correction creates a successor; original preserved).

RetainerRollover.title: Retainer Rollover
RetainerRollover.description: Immutable record of unused-balance carryover from one period's pool to the next (REQ-RETN-004, design D3/D6). Captures the carryover amount/hours after applying the source pool's rollover policy (carryover cap or reset). Immutable after execution; adjustments create a new record.

targetPeriodPoolId.description: FK to the next-period RetainerPool the carryover feeds (REQ-RETN-004/009).

carryoverHours.description: Hours equivalent of the carryover at the pool rate, if rate-convertible (REQ-RETN-004).

carryoverCapApplied.description: Whether the policy carryover cap clamped the carryover (REQ-RETN-004).

resetBalance.description: Whether the source pool policy reset the balance to zero (REQ-RETN-004).

planned.label: Planned
planned.description: Rollover computed at period-end, awaiting execution.

executed.label: Executed
executed.description: Carryover applied to the next-period pool. Immutable (design D6).

adjusted.label: Adjusted
adjusted.description: Superseded by an adjusted successor record.

execute.label: Execute rollover
execute.description: Apply the carryover to the next-period pool (REQ-RETN-009).

RetainerTrueUp.title: Retainer True-Up
RetainerTrueUp.description: Period-end reconciliation of actual drawdown vs. pool amount (REQ-RETN-006, design D5). Computes overage (actualDrawdown − poolAmount, floored at 0) and the overage billing amount at the standard rate resolved from rate-card-engine (REQ-RETN-005). Role-gated approval (REQ-RETN-011); optional adjustment-invoice generation (REQ-RETN-008). Immutable record; reversals/adjustments create a successor linked via reversalOf. invoiceId / approvedBy are entity references (ADR-022).

actualDrawdown.description: Sum of materialized drawdowns in the period (REQ-RETN-006).

poolAmount.description: Configured pool amount for the period (REQ-RETN-006).

overageAmount.description: max(0, actualDrawdown − poolAmount) in retainer-rate terms (REQ-RETN-005/006).

overageRate.description: Standard overage rate resolved from rate-card-engine (NOT the retainer rate) (REQ-RETN-005).

overageInvoiceAmount.description: Overage converted to billing terms = overageAmount / retainerRate × overageRate (REQ-RETN-005).

triggerReason.description: Optional free-text reason for a manual trigger (REQ-RETN-007).

triggeredBy.description: NC user id of the operator who manually triggered the true-up (REQ-RETN-007).

approvedBy.description: NC user id of the approver (REQ-RETN-011).

invoiceId.description: Entity reference to the generated adjustment invoice (REQ-RETN-008).

reversalOf.description: Self-FK to the true-up this record reverses/adjusts (REQ-RETN-007).

status.description: True-up status (REQ-RETN-006/008/011). generated → approved requires retainer:approve-true-up permission.

invoiced.label: Invoiced
invoiced.description: Adjustment invoice generated for the overage (REQ-RETN-008).

settled.label: Settled
settled.description: Invoice paid / period closed; rollover may proceed (REQ-RETN-009).

submit.label: Submit for approval
submit.description: Submit the true-up for approver review (REQ-RETN-011).

approve.label: Approve
approve.description: Approve the true-up. Requires the retainer:approve-true-up permission and a recorded approver (REQ-RETN-011).

settle.label: Settle
settle.description: Mark the true-up settled once the invoice is paid (REQ-RETN-009).

settleNoInvoice.label: Settle without invoice
settleNoInvoice.description: Settle directly when no overage invoice is required (REQ-RETN-008).

reverse.label: Reverse
reverse.description: Reverse an invoiced true-up (correction creates a successor; original preserved) (REQ-RETN-007).
